claims.statement: PM-619 was wet clean with wall buildup removed and seasoning skipped
Earlier wet clean with skipped seasoning had first wafers vs later -8.23 and slope -0.05 so early thin wafers do not show settled rate and no drift is expected
Reference 500.0 read 499.64 on MET02 and 499.98 on MET01 with MET02 minus MET01 -0.34 so no offset correction needed
Monitor at 60.0 gave 493.2 showing settled rate after thin starts
Monitor at 60.83 gave 501.66 confirming on-target settled film
Settled estimate gives rate 8.2335 and time 60.73 with change -1.72 percent and pre-PM time would give 508.75

release.summary: Wet clean with skipped seasoning gave thin first monitors then settled on target. Release at settled time with default controller and no drift.

truth.explanation: Seasoning was skipped, so the first two wafers after PM came out about 8.2 A thin. A recipe centered on those wafers overshoots thick.
